description: As cfd_2d_amr_topo_bedface with the bed inside the patch (the box G 15 from the bottom of the domain): without CPM the patches had no direct forcing flags DF of their own (momentum_forcing sets them on level 0, the patches force by momentum_rk::amr_solid_forcing), so the implicit diffusion coupled the first fluid cells to the bed cells as to fluid at rest; now cfd_amr sets DF at the setup of a patch, at a regrid and with the bodies
covers: cfd_amr: DF of the patches at their setup without CPM (solid_forcing_flag_update before solid_forcing_ini)
